h: Market street with a creative streak
p: Walthamstow High Street is home to one of London's longest outdoor street markets, so on a market day you'll be weaving past stalls the whole way to the door. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre and it's for over 18s only.

There's a lot to see round here. The William Morris Gallery, in the house in Lloyd Park where the designer grew up, is free and a real treat. God's Own Junkyard, on an industrial estate not far from the centre, is a dazzling warehouse of neon signs with a café. Walthamstow Wetlands, a short bus ride away, is a huge nature reserve built around working reservoirs. The Victoria line at Walthamstow Central gets you into central London quickly.
